t: 在西芬之战中,由阿里·伊本·阿布·塔利卜所率领的部队与由穆阿维亚一世所率领的部队发生冲突.
te: In the Battle of Siffin, troops led by Ali ibn Abu Talib clash with those led by Muawiyah I.
dz: 第一腓特烈:在西芬之战中,由阿里·伊本·阿布·塔利卜所率领的部队与由穆阿维亚一世所率领的部队发生冲突.
de: First Fitna: In the Battle of Siffin, troops led by Ali ibn Abu Talib clash with those led by Muawiyah I.

t: 上月尤金一世教宗去世后当选维塔利安教皇.
te: Election of pope Vitalian following the death of pope Eugene I in the previous month.
dz: 上月尤金一世教宗去世后当选维塔利安教皇.
de: Election of pope Vitalian following the death of pope Eugene I in the previous month.
